surface_mechanism_description: A novel ALD reaction (EtCp)Ir(CHD) + O3 yields smooth and conformal coatings in deep pores. The reaction is self-limiting and allows for the deposition of thin coatings in pores by repeating two complementary surface reactions in a cyclic manner.
evidence: The novel ALD reaction (EtCp)Ir(CHD) + O3 yields smooth and conformal coatings in deep pores. A systematic pore length variation yields an electrocatalytically optimal length defined by transport limitation, as the specific surface area is increased sufficiently.
